title: CHAPTER THREE. On the immortality of the soul from the confession of the best philosophers and from reasons
pass_a_gloss: Now the same will stand as demonstrated from the consensus and reasons belonging toward the best philosophers. Hitherto the immortality belonging toward the soul has stood as established from the confession belonging toward the Gentile barbarians. CHAPTER THREE. On the immortality belonging toward the soul from the confession belonging toward the best philosophers and from reasons.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER THREE. On the immortality of the soul from the confession of the best philosophers and from reasons.
Hitherto the immortality of the soul has been established from the confession of the Gentile barbarians: now the same will be demonstrated from the consensus and reasons of the best philosophers.
source_text: CAPUT TERTIUM, De animae immortalitate ex confessione optimorum philosophorum & rationibus. Hactenus constat animae immortalitas ex confessione gentilium barbarorum: jam demonstrabitur eadem ex consensu rationibusque optimorum philosophorum.
